title: Evaluation and Testing
summary: This module provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating and testing AI models and agents, including dataset management, various evaluators, and online evaluation capabilities.

nodes.label: Dataset Management
nodes.title: Dataset Management Module
nodes.description: Tools for defining, generating, and managing datasets used in evaluation and testing, supporting structured data generation and task execution.

nodes.label: Evaluators
nodes.title: Evaluators Module
nodes.description: Provides various evaluators for assessing model outputs, including LLM-based judges, content checks, and statistical evaluators for report generation.

nodes.label: Online Evaluation
nodes.title: Online Evaluation Module
nodes.description: Tools for performing online evaluation of AI models and agents, allowing real-time assessment of performance and behavior, with OpenTelemetry integration.

nodes.label: Testing Utilities
nodes.title: Testing Utilities Module
nodes.description: Various utilities for testing, including VCR cassette management, test file uploads to providers, and verification of cloud service integrations.

nodes.label: Model Integration
nodes.title: Model Integration Module
nodes.description: Handles interactions with various AI models, providing a unified interface for making model requests and managing streamed responses.

nodes.label: Agent Framework
nodes.title: Agent Framework Module
nodes.description: Provides the core framework for defining, running, and managing AI agents, handling user prompts, orchestrating tool calls, and managing agent lifecycle.

groups.label: Evaluation Core
groups.title: Core Evaluation Components
groups.description: The central modules responsible for defining evaluation datasets, running various assessment metrics, and performing real-time online evaluations.

groups.label: Testing Support
groups.title: Testing Support Utilities
groups.description: Provides auxiliary tools and scripts for testing the system, including VCR cassette management and cloud service integration verification.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Module Dependencies
groups.description: Modules from other parts of the system that are crucial for the functionality of the evaluation and testing framework.
